headline.finding: Perceived run wall time rose +16.2% but the merge gate barely moved (+4.5%). The gap is a new NON-GATING job pair.
headline.cause: tests-fips (web) and tests-fips (worker), added by bb1b6645182e90ed2f7f5678ee73d6c958d27869 'feat(docker): create zero vuln base images and add fips mode (#18009)' merged 2026-10-07 08:57:06Z. First run carrying them is 37597253112 (2026-10-07 08:57). They run 211-401s (typically 220-265s) and are now the LONGEST jobs in the run, exceeding tests-web (~200s) and e2e-tests (~140s).
headline.notGating: pipeline.yml's own comment on the job says 'Not part of all-ci-passed yet.' Confirmed empirically: e.g. run 37965772066 (10-09 17:22) perceived 271, all-ci-passed at 220, fips jobs 258/262.
headline.preFipsControl: 2026-10-06 is the only full pre-fips day this week: perceived 225 vs W41's 216.5 (+3.9%), i.e. essentially flat. The entire step change lands on 10-07.
headline.runnerWaitArtifact: runnerWait = perceived - execution, and execution is the UNION of successful job intervals. tests-fips spans nearly the whole run, so the union now nearly equals the full perceived window and almost no gap is left. The 16.5 -> 7.5s drop is NOT a queue improvement. Do not report it as one.
headline.correctMetricNow: Use run_started_at -> all-ci-passed.completed_at ('gated') as the merge-queue metric while a long non-gating job exists. Perceived wall time now overstates developer-visible merge latency by ~25s.

criticalPath.executionMinusE2e: 242.8 - 157.5 = ~85s of execution now sits outside the e2e-tests job, versus ~36s in W41 and ~17.8s in W40.
criticalPath.consequence: e2e-tests is NO LONGER the whole critical path. The gating critical path is now tests-web / tests-worker (ending ~203-209s) rather than e2e (ending ~147s). Per the standing rule, shard-level test optimization is legitimately on the critical path again for the first time in this regime - but see optimizationCandidatesExamined for why nothing was proposed this week.
criticalPath.caveat: Part of that 85s is tests-fips itself, which does not gate. Net of fips, the gating slack is smaller; re-measure next week once fips has a full 7-day history.
